verdict.summary: Round 3 resolves both prior findings. The real prove/verify/mutation integration test is now a required step in the GUI workflow, whose path filters cover the prover, committed ACIR, dependency lockfile, and workflow itself. The challenge is now consistently documented and tested as a fixed domain-separation input with no freshness or replay protection, rather than as a verifier nonce. The ZK claim remains narrowly scoped to knowledge of digits matching a published term anchor and a comparison, explicitly disclaims store/row/credential provenance, and carries the required research-grade/external-audit caveat. The integration test exercises the shipped ACIR through proveFilter and verifyProofBundle and rejects a mutated public claim, so it is non-vacuous. No blocker, correctness, security, or test-validity issue remains in the reviewed diff.
